name: K2 Black Panther
armament: 120 mm CN08 L/55 smoothbore with bustle autoloader (40 rounds)
protection: Modular composite armour with ERA on turret and hull sides; soft-kill smoke, radar and laser warners (K2PL adds hard-kill APS). Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm can only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Length 10.8 m is gun forward; hull 7.5 m
Wedge-fronted angular welded turret with a large rear bustle (autoloader), long L/55 gun with thermal sleeve
Small radar panels and sensor clusters on the turret front corners; commander's panoramic sight on a mast at turret rear-right
Six road wheels per side on in-arm hydropneumatic suspension (hull can kneel or tilt); K2PL hull lengthened by one road-wheel station
Polish vehicles in Polish three-tone or plain olive with white Polish checkerboard insignia
